property_summary: For every caller address, only the deployer/admin (the original msg.sender that constructed C) can change owner via setOwner in the reference; the mutant removes that restriction allowing non-admin callers to change owner, so there exist callers and owner values where owner differs after setOwner.
change_summary: Changed onlyAdmin modifier to always pass (removed the require), allowing setOwner to be called by any address and thus changing owner when non-admins invoke it.
